QUIESCESTATE requires RLS=YES and DFSMS 1.3+ with SMSVSAM; AVAILABILITY is region-local, quiesce is sysplex-wide.

mutations: DSNB REMOVE is not physical dataset deletion; FILE close/region shutdown does not remove DSNB, cold/initial start does. Detach installed FILE references through their owner before REMOVE. No arbitrary limit on DSNB count.

RECOVERED updates catalog BWO state after actual forward recovery or when backup needs no changes; use only with proper BWO support, previous session open, base rather than path, closed FCTs and known recovered state.

RESETLOCKS drops backout/commit failed recovery records and locks, excluding indoubt; can sacrifice integrity. Commit failure may become commit-failed shunt again. CSFL diagnostics are emitted for backout-failed log records, separately from durable audit.

RETRY applies to backout/commit failed shunts after correcting failure, excluding indoubt. UOWACTION applies to indoubt updated work; FORCE honors transaction ACTION. Neither is universal caller rollback.

IMMQUIESCED can purge users throughout sysplex: abend/backout may itself fail and shunt, and an extreme case can fail a region. QUIESCED waits existing work to reach syncpoint, including commit, backout and shunted work.

Quiesce closes eligible files and catalog-marks state; unquiesce reenables only files marked by quiesce, not every UNENABLED file. Non-RLS open can be legal while quiesced; retained RLS locks may bar updates. First mode opened after unquiesce governs later opens.
After outside-RLS work or dataset redefine, explicitly unquiesce to inform CICS even if catalog redefine reset quiesce state.

NOWAIT request acceptance is not completion. WAIT uses QUIESTIM, stated default 240 seconds; inadequate DTIMOUT can cause AEXY. Local timeout SUPPRESSED/38 is distinct from participating-region or exit cancellation SUPPRESSED/37.
